newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-KOENIG LEADS WP FIGHTBACK AGAINST N.TVL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KOENIG LEADS WP FIGHTBACK AGAINST N.TVL.

text.p: Western Province batsman Sven
Koenig hit 97 as the champions fought back against Northern
Transvaal on the the third and penultimate day of their
Supersport Series cricket match at Newlands on Sunday.
Koenig shared a 143 second wicket partnership with Desmond
Haynes (71) to wipe out Province's 135 arrears on first innings.
However Northern Transvaal were still in a useful position
after taking five wickets in the final session to have Western
Province on 342 for six at the close, a lead of 207.
Province lost only the wicket of opener Ryan Maron in the
first two sessions of play. He was caught at silly point for 35
to give Martin van Jaarsveld his maiden first class wicket.
Koenig and Haynes were rarely troubled thereafter with
Koenig seemingly set for a century after crashing a six and two
fours in one Dan van Zyl over to move to 96 at tea.
But he and Haynes fell in successive overs when Northerns
took the new ball immediately on the resumption. Koenig's
innings of five hours 20 minutes included nine fours as well as
his six.
His departure was followed by that of Haynes in ther next
over when he was bowled by Steve Elworhty. The former West
Indies Test opener is still seeking his first first class
century for Province in his third season at Newlands.
HD Ackerman, John Commins and Dave Rundle all fell to
catches behind the wicket at regular intervals to leave the
Province tail exposed and Northern Transvaal handily placed.
